detailed_review.interpolation: For every fixed proposed identity, choose finite ambient tensor/sum realizations including each idempotent and the particular rational module maps. All weights, nonzero denominators and divided-power indices are finite. Infinitely many s_l remain after l exceeds the weight spans and all colors/indices and the finitely many denominator zeros are removed. Generic K weight eigenspaces distinguish integer weights, so maps preserve weights; specialized maps commute with all full toral characters and with divided powers (ordinary divided factorials below l, zero by weight range beyond it). Thus these are actual full-weight tilting maps and idempotent summands, not small-quantum-group substitutes. Every generic matrix equation is a rational function zero at infinitely many distinct roots, hence identically zero. Fixing one finite identity before choosing l covers arbitraryN and arbitrary finite generated objects without any bounded-color conclusion.
